verdict.rationale: Data residency and region selection is a fair question for a SaaS AI observability and evaluation platform like Galileo, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack covers storage regions, residency options, or deployment location choices. The pack covers tracing, metrics, alerts, MCP and the API only, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
